DearMr.Peterson,

Re:RoutineOncologyFollow-upAppointment-Aryepiglotticfoldtumor

Iamwritingtosummariseyourrecentfollow-upappointmentonl0/Jan/2025regardingyourtreatmentforaryepiglotticfoldtumor.

DIAGNOSISANDSTAGING
YouwerediagnosedwithsquamouscellcarcinomaofthearyepiglotticfoldinMarch2022.Initialstagingwas T3N1,StageIVA.Noevidenceofmetastaticdiseasehasbeenidentified.

MOLECULARPROFILE
Tumourtestingshowed:PD-L1(SP263assay)CPS75,TP53Exon8mutation.

TREATMENTHISTORY
-April-June2022:Completedconcurrentchemoradiotherapy(cisplatin+70Gy)withinCLINICALTRIALHPV-NEG-01.
-August2022:Achievedpartialremission(PR)onpost-treatmentimaging.
-Sept2023:ProgressionnotedwithlocaltumourgrowthonMRIneck.
-October2023-May2024:Receivednab-paclitaxel+carboplatinx6cycles.
-July2024:Imagingshowedminimalresponse,diseaseremainedstable.

CURRENTSITUATION
Youattendedclinicwithyourwife.Sincelastappointment,youhaveexperiencedworseningfatigueanddysphagia.Youdescribeweightlossofapprox4kgover3months.Paincontrolisadequatewithcurrentanalgesia.

Physicalexamination:ECOG3,reducedenergy,requiresassistancewithmobility.Visiblecachexia.Youappearanxiousanddiscussedfeelingsoffrustrationregardingprogressingdisease.

Socialhistory:Ex-smoker,40pack-yearhx,quitJan2022.Formeralcoholuse(20units/week),abstinentsincediagnosis.Youlivewithyourwifewhoisprimarycaregiver.

Latestimagingshowsslowprogressionofthelocaltumorwithincreasedsizefrom3.2cmto3.8cm.Noevidentmetastaticdisease.

PLAN
-Continuesupportivecare.
-Referredtopalliativecareteamforsymptommanagement.
-Dieticianreviewfornuritionalsupport.
-Psychologyreviewforfurtherpsychologicalsupport.
-Repeatimagingin8weeks.
-Discussfurthertherapyoptionsatnextreview.

Pleasedonothesitatetocontactusifyouhaveanyquestions.

Yourssincere|y,

Dr.SarahWilliams,MBBS,MRCP,MD
ConsultantMedicalOnco|ogist
RoyalVictoriaHospital,Manchester

Email:s.williams@[redacted]
